# m.partners.etf_global.fund_flows

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Daily fund flows, net asset value, and shares outstanding of US-listed ETFs.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.partners.etf_global.fund_flows(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`, `EffectiveDate` and `ProcessedDate`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | ETF tickers. Leave it out for every fund; `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any field of the rows, such as `"effective_date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"effective_date_gte": "2026-01-01"}`. Keys: `composite_ticker_gt`, `composite_ticker_gte`, `composite_ticker_lt`, `composite_ticker_lte`, `effective_date`, `effective_date_gt`, `effective_date_gte`, `effective_date_lt`, `effective_date_lte`, `processed_date`, `processed_date_gt`, `processed_date_gte`, `processed_date_lt`, `processed_date_lte`. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | ETF Fund Flows (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| ETF Global Fund Flows | Updated daily, All history |
| ETF Global Fund Flows Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `composite_ticker`: "The stock ticker symbol used to identify this ETF on exchanges." |
| `EffectiveDate` | String | The date showing when the information was accurate or valid; some issuers, such as Vanguard, release their data on a delay, so the effective_date can be several weeks earlier than the processed_date. |
| `FundFlow` | double | The net daily capital flow into or out of the ETF through the creation and redemption process, where positive values indicate inflows and negative values indicate outflows. |
| `Nav` | double | The net asset value per share, representing the per-share value of the ETF's underlying holdings. |
| `ProcessedDate` | String | The date showing when ETF Global received and processed the data. |
| `SharesOutstanding` | double | The total number of ETF shares currently issued and outstanding in the market. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
